nodes.name: Run one email now
nodes.notes: Start here while you are testing. Paste one email in the next node with the pin data, or use the Gmail trigger.

nodes.name: New inquiry email
nodes.notes: Fires when a new email arrives. The raw email is in this node's output. Turn off saving execution data if the inbox is sensitive.

nodes.name: Redact personal data
nodes.notes: Replaces names, emails, phones, amounts and street addresses with placeholders before Claude sees the text. Same rules as config/redaction.json.

nodes.name: Claude classify and draft

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-haiku-5-5", max_tokens: 800, system: "You classify one redacted email for a solo bookkeeper and draft a reply that a human must approve. Return JSON with keys category, urgency, service, draft_subject, draft_body. Categories: new_lead, invoice_status, document_request, scheduling, payment_notice, spam, other. Urgency is high or normal. Service is payroll, catch_up, bookkeeping, or general. The draft must say it has not been sent. Do not invent facts that are not in the email. Personal data has already been replaced with placeholders; keep the placeholders, do not guess the originals.", messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.redacted_body }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Calls Claude with the redacted email and the system prompt. The API key lives in the n8n credential named 'Anthropic API' (header x-api-key). It is not in this file. Edit the prompt in the JSON body, or rebuild this file after editing config/prompts.json.

nodes.name: Map fields
nodes.notes: Reads the JSON fields Claude returned: category, urgency, service, draft subject and draft body. Stops if the draft does not say it has not been sent. Later nodes read these fields by name, so a sheet response cannot wipe them.

nodes.name: Add lead row
nodes.notes: Appends one row to the Leads tab: category, urgency, service, draft status, sent=false. Set LEADS_SHEET_ID in the n8n environment. Create those five column headers in row 1 before the first run.

nodes.name: Save draft reply
nodes.notes: Saves a Gmail draft with the subject and body from Map fields. It does not send.

nodes.name: Human approval
nodes.notes: Pauses until a person opens the approval link. Leave this node in the path. That is the approval switch, on.

nodes.name: Approved?
nodes.notes: True only when the approval link was confirmed. The false branch stops at 'Leave as draft'.

nodes.name: Leave as draft
nodes.notes: Approval was not given. The draft stays in Gmail. Nothing is sent.

nodes.name: Send reply
nodes.notes: Sends the reply. This node ships disabled. It is only reachable after Human approval and only on the true branch of Approved?. Enable it only after you have used the draft path for a while.
